description: Independently enumerated LLM call sites, read out of the four repositories by hand rather than produced by the scanner. Generating this list from the scanner would make the recall gate circular: it would only ever prove the scanner agrees with itself. Recall is asserted at FILE granularity because line numbers move with every unrelated edit, while the claim under test - 'this file reaches a model and the scan knows it' - does not.
method: Read of import graphs and call expressions across engine/src, utils/src, lumic-utils/src and backend-legacy/src, cross-checked against the migration doc's named entry points.
